about.title: About Timro-Ticket
about.description: Events bring people together — and we believe every connection creates a story worth remembering. We make those moments simpler, smoother, and more accessible to everyone in Nepal.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: We empower organizers with smart tools to manage, promote, and sell events — while giving audiences the easiest way to discover and book exciting experiences happening around them.
mission.p2: From concerts to conferences, we support Nepal's growing event culture with seamless digital solutions.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: We started with a simple idea: Nepal has countless events happening every day — but discovering them shouldn't be so complicated. There was enthusiasm, creativity, passion… yet a lack of digital connection between organizers and audiences.
story.p2: Today, thousands of people rely on Timro-Ticket to find their next unforgettable experience — and we're just getting started.
story.slogan: “Your next greatest memory starts with a ticket.”

whatAreCookies.title: What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.p1: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and provide valuable information to website owners.
whatAreCookies.p2: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, and how you can control your cookie preferences.

manage.title: How to Manage Cookies
manage.intro: You can control and manage cookies in various ways. Most browsers allow you to:
manage.bullet1: View and delete cookies stored on your device
manage.bullet4: Clear all cookies when closing the browser

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.p1: We may also use cookies from third-party services such as Google Analytics, social media platforms, and payment processors. These cookies are set by the third parties and are subject to their own privacy policies.
thirdParty.p2: While we do not have direct control over these cookies, you can manage them through your browser settings or the third-party's privacy preferences.

consent.title: Cookie Consent
consent.p1: When you first visit our website, you will see a cookie banner asking for your consent to place non-essential cookies on your device. You can change your cookie preferences at any time by:
consent.bullet1: Clicking the cookie settings link in our footer

updates.title: Updates to This Policy
updates.p1: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology, legal requirements, or our practices. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the 'Last Updated' date.

q1.question: How do I purchase tickets?
q1.answer: To purchase tickets, simply browse events on our platform, select your desired event, choose the number of tickets, and proceed to checkout. You'll receive digital tickets via email after successful payment.

q3.question: Can I transfer my tickets to someone else?
q3.answer: Yes, most tickets are transferable. You can transfer tickets through your account dashboard by selecting the ticket and clicking 'Transfer'. The recipient will receive an email with instructions to claim the ticket.

q4.question: What if I lose my ticket QR code?
q4.answer: Don't worry! You can always access your tickets from your account dashboard. Simply log in, go to 'My Tickets', and you'll find all your QR codes there. You can also request a resend of the confirmation email.

q2.question: Where can I find my tickets after purchase?
q2.answer: Your tickets are available in two places: 1) Your email inbox (check spam folder if not found), and 2) Your account dashboard under 'My Tickets' section. You can also download them from the order confirmation page.

q5.question: Is there a limit on how many tickets I can buy?
q5.answer: Ticket limits vary by event. Some events may have a maximum purchase limit per person to ensure fair distribution. This information is displayed on the event page before purchase.

q6.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q6.answer: We accept various payment methods including credit/debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), mobile banking, digital wallets (Google Pay, Apple Pay), and bank transfers. Available methods vary by region.

q7.question: Is my payment information secure?
q7.answer: Absolutely! We use industry-standard encryption and never store your full payment details. All transactions are processed through secure, PCI-compliant payment gateways.

q8.question: How do I request a refund?
q8.answer: To request a refund, contact our support team within the refund window with your order ID. Refunds are processed according to our Refund Policy. Visit our Refund Policy page for detailed information.

q9.question: How long does it take to process a refund?
q9.answer: Refunds typically take 5-10 business days to process, depending on your payment method and bank. You'll receive a confirmation email once the refund is initiated.

q10.question: What are the service fees for?
q10.answer: Service fees cover platform maintenance, customer support, secure payment processing, and feature development. These fees are clearly displayed before checkout.

q11.question: How do I create an account?
q11.answer: Click the 'Sign Up' button on our homepage, enter your email address, create a password, and follow the verification steps. You can also sign up using Google or Facebook for faster registration.

q12.answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your registered email address, and we'll send you a password reset link. Follow the instructions in the email to create a new password.
q12.question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?

q13.question: How do I update my profile information?
q13.answer: Log into your account, go to 'Profile Settings', and update your information. You can change your name, email address, phone number, and notification preferences.

q14.question: Can I delete my account?
q14.answer: Yes, you can delete your account by contacting our support team. Please note that this action is permanent and will remove all your data, including ticket purchase history.

q15.question: How do you protect my personal information?
q15.answer: We use advanced security measures including encryption, secure servers, and regular security audits. We never share your personal information with third parties without your consent.

q16.question: What should I do if I receive a suspicious email about my tickets?
q16.answer: Do not click any links or provide personal information. Forward the suspicious email to our support team and delete it immediately. Always access your tickets through our official website.

q17.question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
q17.answer: Go to Account Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. You can enable it using an authenticator app (like Google Authenticator) or SMS verification for added security.

q18.question: What happens if an event is canceled?
q18.answer: If an event is canceled, all ticket holders will receive a full refund automatically. You'll be notified via email with further instructions. No action is required on your part.

q19.question: What if an event is rescheduled?
q19.answer: If an event is rescheduled, your tickets will be valid for the new date. You'll receive an email notification with the updated details. If you cannot attend the new date, you can request a refund.

q20.question: What items are prohibited at events?
q20.answer: Prohibited items vary by venue and event type. Common prohibited items include weapons, outside food/drinks, professional cameras, and large bags. Check the event page for specific restrictions.

q21.question: Can I get a refund if I can't attend?
q21.answer: Refunds for non-attendance are generally not provided unless specified in the event terms. However, most tickets can be transferred to someone else. Check our Refund Policy for more details.
